"""Independent synthetic TF SegFormer segmentation reference; no original weights."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import SegformerConfig,TFSegformerForSemanticSegmentation

OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
config=SegformerConfig(depths=[1,1,1,1],hidden_sizes=[8,16,24,32],num_attention_heads=[1,2,3,4],
    mlp_ratios=[2,2,2,2],decoder_hidden_size=16,num_labels=3,drop_path_rate=0.0,
    hidden_dropout_prob=0.0,attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.0,classifier_dropout_prob=0.0,
    image_size=32,id2label={0:'sky',1:'tree',2:'road'},label2id={'sky':0,'tree':1,'road':2})
model=TFSegformerForSemanticSegmentation(config)
pixels=np.linspace(-1,1,3072,dtype=np.float32).reshape(1,3,32,32)
model(pixel_values=tf.constant(pixels),training=False)
rng=np.random.default_rng(6160)
for w in model.weights:
    values=rng.normal(0,0.04,w.shape).astype(np.float32)
    if w.name.endswith(('gamma:0','moving_variance:0')):values+=1
    w.assign(values)
result=model(pixel_values=tf.constant(pixels),training=False,output_hidden_states=True)
model.save_pretrained(OUT,safe_serialization=False)
np.savez(OUT/'reference.npz',pixel_values=pixels,logits=result.logits.numpy(),**{f'encoder_{i}':v.numpy() for i,v in enumerate(result.hidden_states)})
(OUT/'weights.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'name':w.name,'shape':list(w.shape)} for w in model.weights],indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(model.weights),result.logits.shape,flush=True)
